title: ಅಂತ್ಯ ಕಾಲ ಸ್ಮರಣೆ
charanas:
ಕರುಳ ಕುಡಿ
ಕರೆದೊರೆಯಲು
ಧಾವಿಸಿ ಬರುವ
ಗೋವಿನಂತೆ

ಯಮನು ಕರೆವ
ಸಮಯದಿ ಅವ-
-ಸರದಿ ಹರಿಯ
ಸ್ಮರಿಸಿ ಸವಿವಗೆ

ಅಜಮಿಳಗೊಲಿದ
ಅಜಭವಪಿತ ಶ್ರೀ
ಮುಕುಂದ ವಿಠಲ
ಮುಕುತಿ ಕೊಡುವ

charanas.en: Just a cow runs towards a calf when it hears her son screaming.
When Yama' invitation arrives (time of death is approaching), One who immediately (through the grace of Hari) remembers the Lord and think of His pasttimes.

The supreme lord, who showered grace to Ajamila who was a sinner beyond description, who is the creator of all entities, that Mukunda Vittala, will surely swiftly provide deliverance to such pure devotees just as swiftly as the cow runs and cares for her calf.

summary.en: Just like a calf, screaming and vailing, gets pacified by the mother cow swiftly, A pure devotee who is absorbed in thoughts of the lord at the time of death, will be swiftly delivered by the lord Mukunda, just like Ajamila was delivered upon hearing his call to Narayana.
